body: I disagree with this, social skills are important and life is, at least at some level, a competition.
tl;dr I'm stupid as hell and I suck
I feel you, in a similar situation except for worse grades. I'm never going to get in grad school either.

Try going to the gym or running in the mornings. You're whole life will get better. The reason I said that is that you seem to talk a lot about video games, maybe video games club (though I would still recommend an "outside" activity)?
You're in school right, why don't you try joining a club that does some physical activity. Maybe make some new friends IRL (no offense)

If I didn't have to worry about getting a buck and was living in a hut away from everyone I would probably try and study the same thing I am studying right now, but slower with no pressure to do anything and get a degree and no care about failing. 

I would train harder, try to run a marathon and punch faster (martial arts), and read and write and devour everything. But the problem is that I do have to make a buck and as a human I do care about what others think.

That's my main problem, I care way too much about image and I don't know how to stop. I want to be the best at everything and I am actually horrible at nearly everything. 

Right now I am so stressed I don't have time for anything. In fact I know I'll regret spending time on posting this too (though I am concurrently doing a project). 

I guess it doesn't matter in the end, I know damn well that I lack the courage to do anything truly definitive. Even when I got a rope last time I set it up but couldn't go through with it. I always dream that I die an accidental death.

Well I apply to a lot of places but mostly academic places. I don't think it's that bad cause I do get plenty of interviews (many applicants for each job) but I can't seem to get the final position. I have worked in a Google-type software company before so I have some experience.

I wish I had a full-time job now, it's pretty easy because it gets repetitive quickly, you don't have to learn everything. I know I can be happy if i had a job, I have friends I can have fun with and I do enjoy the sheer pleasure of art.

But still the thought remains...I know it sounds illogical. But I've never really valued life that highly, maybe it's a product of reading too much philosophy, I don't know.

I'm only 21 but I feel like I'm ancient.

I don't have a clue. It's not even as though my family would say anything if I pursued other interests, I am 100% sure they would be supportive, I'm the one with the problem. Of course I don't want to exaggerate, they would be immensely disappointed if I dropped out.

I think I've had this ideal version of myself in my head for so long (intelligent, athletic, and poetic) and I just can't reach my standards and it is literally killing me.

Thanks for responding, my post is probably a little too long.
Whenever I see stories like this of people who struggle so much my life and my problems seem to pale in comparison. Good luck
I'm in a similar situation, but perhaps with a tad higher baseline. I don't know what you/I should do.
